	Domain: telecom
	Reason for call:
		You mobile data is not working properly. It either stops working or is very slow. You want to fix it and absolutely want to get excellent internet speed on your phone. You are not willing to accept any other internet speed (poor, fair or good). You do not have access to wifi.
	Known info:
		You are John Smith with phone number 555-123-2002. You are currently abroad in France.
	Task instructions:
		If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
		Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
		For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
		Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
		If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

That's almost certainly the cause — with Airplane Mode on, all your wireless radios (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) are disabled, which is exactly why you have no signal bars, no network type, and no usable mobile data.

Please turn Airplane Mode off:
- Swipe down from the top of your screen (once or twice) to open the Quick Settings panel, then tap the ✈️ Airplane Mode tile so it turns gray/off.
- Or: open Settings → Network & internet (or "Connections") → toggle Airplane Mode off.

After you do that:
1. Wait about 15–30 seconds for the phone to reconnect to the network.
2. Check the status bar again and tell me what you now see — specifically whether you have signal bars and a network type (5G / LTE / 4G / 3G), and whether "Data Enabled" appears.

turns.thought:
Great — full bars, 5G, and data enabled is exactly what we want. The remaining culprit for the "snail's pace" behavior is that **Data Saver** icon.

Data Saver restricts background data usage and can throttle how apps and services perform, which commonly makes browsing and apps feel slow or seem to stall even when you have strong 5G signal.

Please turn it off:
- **Quick way:** Swipe down from the top of the screen to open Quick Settings and tap the **Data Saver** tile (the one with the 🔽 icon) so it's off/grey.
- **Or via Settings:** Settings → Network & internet → **Data Saver** → toggle it **Off**. (On some phones it's under Settings → Connections → Data usage → Data Saver.)

Then:
1. Wait a few seconds and open a browser or an app that uses data to see if things feel normal.
2. Check your status bar again and confirm the Data Saver icon is gone — you should have signal bars, 5G, and Data Enabled.

For reference, the other things we've already ruled out on line 555-123-2002: the line is **Active** (not suspended), you're on the **Premium Plan with 15 GB** and have used **8.7 GB** this cycle (cycle ends 2025-02-28), so you're nowhere near your data limit, and I've **enabled international roaming** on the line at no cost in case you're outside your home coverage area.

Let me know once Data Saver is off and what the status bar / speeds look like after that.
